//! The rollback module.

use std::fmt;

/// A rollback plan.
///
/// It lists the steps in order.
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct RollbackPlan {
    steps: Vec<String>,
}

impl RollbackPlan {
    /// Build an empty plan.
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }

    pub fn apply_step(&mut self, step: &str) {
        fn helper() {}
        self.steps.push(step.to_owned());
    }
}

impl fmt::Display for RollbackPlan {
    fn fmt(&self, out: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        write!(out, "{}", self.steps.len())
    }
}

pub trait Planner {
    fn plan(&self) -> RollbackPlan;
}

pub enum Mode {
    Fast,
    Safe,
}

pub const LIMIT: usize = 3;
static NAME: &str = "plan";
pub type Steps = Vec<String>;

mod inner {
    pub fn deep() {}
}

macro_rules! shout {
    () => {};
}

// Not a doc comment, but directly above.
pub fn free_function() {}
